Coram : D.Y. CHANDRACHUD*, J.B. PARDIWALA, MANOJ MISRA
Issue for Consideration Whether after 01 April 2021, the Income Tax Act, 1961 has to be read along with the substituted provisions; whether Taxation and Other Laws (Relaxation and Amendment of Certain Provisions) Act 2020 (TOLA) will continue to apply to the Income Tax Act after 01 section 3(1) of TOLA overrides section 149 of the Income Tax Act; whether TOLA will extend the time limit for the grant of sanction by the authority specified under section 151 of the Income Tax Act; whether the directions in Ashish Agarwal will extend to all the reassessment notices issued
Decision Date : 03-10-2024 | Case No : CIVIL APPEAL No. 8629/2024 | Disposal Nature : Disposed off | Bench : 3 Judges
